# danish: Jeg arbejder på et lille kontor i København.
english: I work in a small office in Copenhagen.

# danish: Min kollega hjælper mig med den nye opgave.
english: My colleague is helping me with the new task.

# danish: Mødet begynder klokken ni og varer en time.
english: The meeting starts at nine and lasts an hour.

# danish: Kan du sende dagsordenen inden mødet?
english: Can you send the agenda before the meeting?

# danish: Jeg arbejder hjemmefra to dage om ugen.
english: I work from home two days a week.

# danish: Vi holder frokostpause i kantinen.
english: We take our lunch break in the canteen.

# danish: Hvornår er fristen for at aflevere rapporten?
english: When is the deadline for submitting the report?

# danish: Jeg vil gerne søge stillingen som receptionist.
english: I would like to apply for the position of receptionist.

# danish: Hun har sendt sit CV og en kort ansøgning.
english: She has sent her CV and a short application.

# danish: Jobsamtalen gik godt, men jeg har ikke fået svar endnu.
english: The job interview went well, but I have not received an answer yet.

# danish: Han er medlem af en fagforening.
english: He is a member of a trade union.

# danish: Jeg har fri på fredag.
english: I have Friday off.

# danish: Vi skal finde en løsning sammen.
english: We need to find a solution together.

# danish: Jeg går på sprogskole om aftenen.
english: I attend language school in the evening.

# danish: Vores lærer forklarer grammatikken med eksempler.
english: Our teacher explains the grammar with examples.

# danish: Kan du gentage det lidt langsommere?
english: Can you repeat that a little more slowly?

# danish: Vi skal læse kapitel tre til på mandag.
english: We need to read chapter three for Monday.

# danish: Jeg øver min udtale hver dag.
english: I practise my pronunciation every day.

# danish: Eksamen består af en skriftlig og en mundtlig del.
english: The exam consists of a written and an oral part.

# danish: Det er i orden at lave fejl, mens man lærer.
english: It is all right to make mistakes while learning.
